page.layout: One blank page of paper; no printed text blocks. Only stains and a dark mark at the lower left and a small spot at the lower centre, which are not printing.
page.notes: Blank leaf: no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword or signature. The brown smudges at the lower left and lower centre and the faint tonal patches are stains or show-through, not print. The dark background at the edges is the book's cover or the scanning surround, not part of the page.
